fields.DESCRIPTION: The Sage Boho Fringe Backpack is the perfect blend of style and utility for modern free spirits. Handcrafted with soft cotton fabric, it features a calming sage green and ivory woven pattern, playful fringes, and textured details that exude bohemian charm. Designed with sturdy drawstring closure and ample space, this backpack is ideal for daily use, travel, or casual outings—keeping you effortlessly chic and comfortable.
